title: Beyond Known Facts: Generating Unseen Temporal Knowledge to Address Data Contamination in LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing knowledge graph extraction performance on a dataset of known, historical facts (YAGO 2022) against a synthetic dataset of unseen, future facts (YAGO 2026) to quantify how much training data memorization artificially inflates LLM performance.

Swapping the years in the text prompts (e.g., changing 2022 timestamps to 2026, and vice versa) and measuring the resulting changes in extraction F1-scores to isolate the model's performance bias toward contemporary or seen years versus future timestamps.
